- **Module 4**: Swipe Engine, Gesture Physics & Vector Recommendation (`packages/core`, `apps/consumer-app`) [TASK-111 to TASK-140] (30 Tasks)
- **Module 5**: Partner Profile Sync, Taste Blending & Affiliate Catalog [TASK-141 to TASK-165] (25 Tasks)
- **Module 6**: UI Kit Design System & Atomic Components (`packages/ui-kit`) [TASK-166 to TASK-190] (25 Tasks)

## Module 1: Core Domain Entities & Zod Validation Schemas (`packages/core/src/domain`) [TASK-001 to TASK-030]

### TASK-001: Product Entity & Zod Schema Definition
- **Task ID**: TASK-001
- **Title**: Implement Product Entity and Zod Validation Schema
- **Layer / Package**: `packages/core`
- **Hexagonal Role**: Domain Entity / Zod Validation
- **Detailed Description**: Create `packages/core/src/catalog/domain/Product.ts`. Define the core `Product` interface and corresponding `ProductSchema` using Zod (`z.object({...})`). Include attributes: `id`, `title`, `brand`, `price` (number), `originalMrp` (number), `discountPercentage` (number), `category` (string), `gender` ('men' | 'women' | 'unisex'), `sizes` (array of strings), `colors` (array of strings), `images` (array of image URLs), `embedding` (array of 384 numbers), `affiliateUrl` (string), and `inStock` (boolean). Export TypeScript type `Product = z.infer<typeof ProductSchema>`.
- **Coding Standards Compliance**: Strictly use Zod for schema definition (`z.object`). No `any` or `as any` type casting allowed. Define explicit type interfaces.
- **Acceptance Criteria**: `ProductSchema.parse()` successfully validates valid product data and throws Zod error for missing/invalid types; zero `any` types in file.
